title: AGRO: ADVERSARIAL DISCOVERY OF ERROR-PRONE GROUPS FOR ROBUST OPTIMIZATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group accuracy in natural language inference tasks on subgroups containing specific spurious textual correlations, such as negation words or lexical overlap (MultiNLI dataset).

Evaluating worst-group image classification accuracy on subgroups where foreground objects appear in atypical or mismatched backgrounds, such as waterbirds on land or landbirds on water (Waterbirds dataset).
Evaluating worst-group facial attribute classification accuracy on rare intersections of gender and physical characteristics, such as male blondes or blondes wearing eyeglasses (CelebA dataset).
Evaluating worst-group text classification accuracy on toxic versus non-toxic comments that mention specific racial demographics, such as 'Black' (CivilComments dataset).
Evaluating worst-group text classification accuracy on toxic versus non-toxic comments that mention LGBTQ demographic terms (CivilComments dataset).
Evaluating worst-group text classification accuracy on toxic versus non-toxic comments that mention religious identity terms (CivilComments dataset).
